items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the derived internal hom of a strictly perfect complex with an arbitrary complex termwise (statement lines 11911-11924). The proof (proof lines 11926-11956) represents the derived internal hom by the product complex attached to a K-injective resolution, compares the two complexes degree by degree through the local comparison lemma identifying their sheafified cohomology, and concludes quasi-isomorphism. H2: one comparison lemma applied degree by degree, written out.
